summary: Freezes the P4-12/P4-13 Prism report archive migration cohort and requires any later formal Prism reports to be recorded as post-freeze reports instead of silently changing the current archive plan.

forbidden_claims: Prism reports have not been physically migrated.
Old prism/reports anchors have not been retired or replaced.
raw run evidence has not been cleaned.
The prism-layer-and-evidence blocker is not closed.
RedCap is not public-release-ready because of this guard alone.

freeze_policy.new_report_handling: Formal Prism reports added after this guard are allowed to remain under prism/reports only when they are listed in post_freeze_reports and explicitly excluded from the current archive plan.
freeze_policy.unlisted_new_report_policy: Any live prism/reports/*.md file that is not part of the frozen mapping set and is not listed in post_freeze_reports must fail validation.
freeze_policy.next_plan_refresh_policy: A future live apply or archive-plan refresh may absorb post-freeze reports only through a new explicit route decision, Prism review and closeout receipt.

post_freeze_reports.required_before_future_plan_refresh: A future route decision must explicitly decide whether to refresh the frozen archive cohort before live apply.

required_before_future_apply: Run the churn/freeze guard check and confirm no unlisted post-freeze reports exist.
Run the copy-first plan check and confirm frozen mappings still match old anchors.
Run the readiness rehearsal and confirm only the frozen cohort is rehearsed.
Run package manifest checks and confirm report/raw evidence paths stay excluded.
Run Prism independent review before any live apply, old-anchor retirement or raw evidence cleanup.
